title: A Study on the Development Direction of Generative AI and Human Collaboration in Popular Music Creation: Focusing on Case Studies

contributions.purpose: 归纳 AI-人协作流行音乐的成就与挑战
contributions.mechanism: 定性案例研究,选取 2019 年后 8 个代表性案例(Artificial Digitality、SophiaPop、FN Meka、Heart on My Sleeve、Now and Then 等)
contributions.evaluation: 成就:支持创造力/突破身体与文化障碍/民主化/新协作环境;局限:人类仍主导问题识别、规划、最终决策(定性,无指标)
contributions.domain: 生成式 AI 与音乐创作/伦理
contributions.source_quote: This study analyzed the achievements and challenges of generative AI-human collaboration in the field of popular music and proposed future directions.

contributions.purpose: 提出应对版权与伦理问题的制度方案
contributions.mechanism: 三项互补方案:AI 创作验证程序、基于区块链/智能合约的自动版税分配系统、音乐分发中的 AI 使用标注(三分类)
contributions.evaluation: 定性方案设想,无实现或评测
contributions.source_quote: we propose the development of an AI verification program, an automated royalty distribution system, and improvements to the music distribution system through AI usage indicators

notes: 非实证类:定性案例研究,无任何量化指标。数据红旗(多):全文无 Agents4Science checklist(强制项缺失)——desk-reject 直接原因;章节标题重复错乱——4.1 与 4.2 同名“Artificial Digitality”(4.2 实为另一歌曲);数字被吞/串行——市场“6.2 billion in 2025 ... 38.7 billion by 2033 ... 25.8This study”(缺 % 且句子粘连)、Grimes 分成“50”截断、三分类标签“100%”多处截断成“100From/100In”;同一歌曲音译前后不一(Dahaejuttyeon/Dahaejootdang/Dahaejootjan)。整体呈机器翻译痕迹(韩语源)。由 abstract+conclusion 归纳 2 条贡献。desk-reject。
